title: Chapter 905
text:
The amount of experience reward was about the same as the Tyrant's Challenge Mission. Completing all the requirements would give him more than twenty billion experience. Basically, all missions that required him to face a Beyond Grade A Super would have such a reward.

With the bonus of Political Assets, Han Xiao's actual experience doubled, and his savings increased by a large amount.

The other two rewards were Legendary Point and Character Summon Card.

Star Field Legendary Point (Shattered Star Ring): [Battle of the Dragon Emperor] — Your battle with the Dragon Emperor Ames will be added to your resume. Your name will be spread far and wide.

At the same time, each of your melee attacks will deal 20,000 – 26,000 additional physical damage. When using Strength Judgment, you will receive an additional 1,500 damage. This effect lasts for 30 minutes. Usage limit: 0/3.

"The effect is pretty good. It will come in handy in close combat." Han Xiao nodded and closed the interface.

After cleaning up the battlefield, Floating Dragon returned home, and Han Xiao followed.

The battlefield was not far from Planet Aquamarine, and Floating Dragon returned to Planet Aquamarine without spending much time on the way. It stopped in outer space.

Spaceships took off and landed on this blue planet one after another. Now that Planet Aquamarine was connected to the galactic society, the development opportunities brought by the galactic financial groups allowed Planet Aquamarine's civilization level to increase rapidly. Now, it already looked like a galactic city.

After returning to his mother planet, Han Xiao planned to inspect the changes in Blue Star. After thinking about it, he decided to invite Ames along.

Although Ames did not seem to care about losing, Han Xiao needed to eliminate any negative factors to maintain their relationship as allies. Thus, he took this opportunity to spend time with Ames and strengthen their relationship, minimizing the negative effects of the battle.

Ames looked down at the Blue Star from the sky every day, but she rarely visited the surface cities. Since Han Xiao invited her, she did not reject.

The New Western Capital was the capital of Stardragon, one of the six nations of Hai Lan.

The Black Star City that Bennett was in was where the army's sub-base was located. It was also the political core of the Aquamarine Federation. It continued to expand in the Gorst Wilderness and attracted countless people. Now, it was almost saturated. Later, the galactic financial groups set their eyes on other big cities that were not so strictly controlled and built many economic cities. The New Western Capital was developed in this way and was a first-tier city of the Blue Star.

It was just past noon, and the bright sunlight infused the city with exuberant vitality. The bustling streets were bustling with activity. Not only were there Blue Star humans, but there were also other galactic races occasionally. There was an endless stream of hovering cars in the sky, and when they passed overhead, they brought with them the slight humming sound of the anti-gravity engine. Convenient public trains carried the citizens and traveled in an orderly manner on the crisscrossing rail network in the city. Everywhere they looked, it was a peaceful scene.

Han Xiao and Ames hid their auras and deliberately lowered their presence in the eyes of others so that no one would notice their existence.

The two of them walked side by side on the streets and casually observed the situation in the city. They stopped and chatted along the way.

Two children chasing each other ran past Han Xiao with carefree and happy smiles on their faces.

Han Xiao retracted his gaze and sighed.

"It has been more than ten years since the Mutation Disaster, and the Blue Star people have already walked out of the shadows. They have opened their hearts and embraced a new life, giving birth to a new generation. This feeling is really good."

"This is all your work. Do you feel a sense of accomplishment?" Ames chuckled.

"A little."

Han Xiao was not embarrassed to admit it. Although he had chosen to save his mother planet, it was completely for the sake of his own interests. He had only done so for the sake of the Blue Star players. However, looking at the current results, he was indeed quite satisfied. After all, there were not many people who did not like beautiful things.

"During the Mutation Disaster, you invited me to visit your mother planet. At that time, the feeling that Blue Star gave me was one of despair and nervousness. The people were confused about the future and did not know if they could live past tomorrow. It's completely different from now." Ames shook her head. "You gave this planet a new lease of life."

"I guess I'm the so-called turning point in history, haha."

Han Xiao laughed. When interacting with people he was close to in private, he would not be so humble and polite.

As they chatted, the two of them unknowingly arrived at the city center. A tall building that reached into the clouds entered their vision. That was the old site of the Dragon Horn Building in Stardragon, but it had been renovated into a new building. It was a branch building built by a galactic financial group.

Seeing this building, Han Xiao stopped in his tracks. Memories flooded his mind, and he could not help but feel as if a lifetime had passed.

At this moment, Ames seemed to have noticed something. She turned around, and her eyes lit up with interest. She immediately reached out and tugged on Han Xiao's sleeve.

"Look, what's that shop?"

Han Xiao retracted his gaze and followed her line of sight. He saw a shop by the street with the sign 'Black Star Cultural Relic Exhibition Hall' written on it!

"I've actually become a cultural relic … It's only been less than twenty years."

Han Xiao could not help but complain. Curiosity grew in his heart, and he followed Ames over.

The automatic glass door opened, and the two of them walked into the exhibition hall. They saw that it was a small three-story building with glass cabinets filled with all kinds of items.

At this time, this small exhibition hall was deserted, and there was not a single person in sight. There was a counter at the entrance, and there was a sign with the price of the tickets written on it. A woman was sitting behind the counter. She seemed to be an employee, and her upper body was on the table. She was taking an afternoon nap and did not hear the two of them walking in.

With the eyesight of a Beyond Grade A, Han Xiao instantly saw the situation in this exhibition hall. When he saw the items in the glass cabinets, the corners of his mouth twitched.

"What the hell are all these things …"

This exhibition hall displayed all kinds of random things, such as' The Chair Black Star Sat On ',' The Slippers Black Star Wore ',' The Bread Black Star Took a Bite of '… and even' The Toilet Bowl Used by Black Star Once '.

Han Xiao swore that he had never seen the toilet bowl in this glass cabinet before!

Ames blinked, pointed at one of the cabinets, and curiously asked, "Did you really like wearing diapers in the past?"

"You're the one who wears diapers!"

"Who hasn't worn diapers when they were still babies?" Ames shrugged.

Their conversation alarmed the female employee lying on the counter. She raised her head, rubbed her sleepy eyes, and walked out from behind the counter. She walked in front of the two of them, yawned, and said, "This is a small business.

We don't accept Enas for payment. The entrance fee is 400 Aquamarine Credits. I will introduce the origin of each artifact to you. If you're interested … hmm? "

This woman suddenly saw the appearance of the two of them clearly. She had just finished yawning, and her mouth was still open. Her face was filled with shock.

Han Xiao originally wanted to ask where these 'artifacts' came from, but when he saw the appearance of this woman, he suddenly felt that she looked familiar. "Wait a minute, I think I know you …"

Before he finished speaking, this woman's face suddenly became excited. She suddenly opened her arms, as though she wanted to rush forward and hug them.

However, just as she made this gesture, her face suddenly froze. As though she had thought of something, her hands hung in the air, and she did not hug them.

The next moment, she awkwardly put down her hands, and her expression became uneasy, as though she did not know where to place her hands. She probed, "Han … no, Your Excellency Black Star, do you still remember me?"

Han Xiao frowned slightly and carefully observed the woman in front of him. There were slight wrinkles at the corners of her eyes. She seemed to be a little old, but she still had her charm. She should have been very beautiful when she was young. Her body was tall and curvaceous. However, under the vision of a Beyond Grade A, this kind of beauty was not attractive at all.

Every Promotion was a process of improving one's body composition. A Beyond Grade A would be able to see the smallest structure clearly. Most creatures were covered in dirt in the eyes of a Beyond Grade A, but in the eyes of a Beyond Grade A, only creatures of the same Beyond Grade A level were 'clean' and would not be stained by dirt and dust.

Han Xiao compared the faces in his memory and instantly found an image that matched. He raised his eyebrows and was a little surprised.

"You're … Li Yalin?"

This woman in front of him was his partner when he was in the Stardragon Special Agent Agency.

Seeing that Han Xiao had recognized her, Li Ya Lin became excited again and nodded like a chick pecking rice.

"It's me, it's me. You actually still remember me!"

"It's more troublesome for me to forget things than to remember things." Han Xiao explained. He then asked curiously, "So, you're still alive. I thought you died in the Mutation Disaster. Since you survived, why didn't you go to the Black Star Corps base to find me?"

"It wasn't easy for me to survive. After the Six Nations were destroyed by you, I lost my job and received a severance package. I didn't want to fight anymore, so I didn't look for you. Instead, I bought a house here and opened an exhibition hall. "

Li Yalin suddenly thought of the things in the exhibition hall and smiled awkwardly. "Er … about that, I got these things from the old market to pass them off as things that you've used before. I hope you don't mind …"

"… Don't worry, I won't hold it against you."

Meeting an old friend, Han Xiaoxin's mood improved.

"Old friend?" Ames suddenly asked after watching from the side for a while.

"Yes, an old friend from more than twenty years ago." Han Xiao nodded.

Li Yalin's attention was all on Han Xiao and had neglected Ames in her shock. Only now did she recover from her shock and hurriedly bowed. "Greetings, Your Excellency Dragon Emperor. I apologize for not noticing you earlier. Please forgive me."

Ames smiled and nodded, indicating that it was fine.

"Sigh, you and I are old friends. There's no need to be so restrained." Han Xiao waved his hands.

"How can I do that?" Li Yalin was a little uneasy. "You're already a real big shot now."

More than twenty years had passed, and her old friend had already reached a level that she could never reach. He was a Great Person of the Planet who frequently appeared on the news. Li Yalin had forcefully stopped herself from hugging Han Xiao earlier because she thought of the huge gap between their identities.

Han Xiao also realized this. He could not help but feel that things were still the same, but the people had changed. He thought about it and smiled.

"Now that I think about it, I seem to owe you a sum of money."

Li Yalin was stunned for a moment before waving her hands. "That was so long ago. I don't care about it anymore. You don't have to …"

"Alright, I've already transferred the money to you. Take a look." Han Xiao interrupted her.

Beep! The sound of the communicator accepting a message could be heard in the room.

"Tsk, I didn't tell you my account number. How did you know?" Li Yalin was shocked. She had no choice but to take out the communicator from the drawer. With just one glance, her whole body froze.

"This, this …"

"One million Enas. This amount should be enough to compensate for the interest for more than twenty years."

Han Xiao smiled and felt that he was exuding a golden aura.

"That's too much!" Li Yalin was at a loss.

"This is nothing to me. At most, it's pocket money. Just keep it and don't have to worry about living in the future …" Han Xiao looked around, coughed, and said, "So find a time to close this shop."

Ames could not help but laugh.

"You look very much like those galactic pirates who paid me protection fees in the past."

"No one will think you're mute if you don't talk," Han Xiao said with annoyance.

Seeing that Li Yalin was still in disbelief, Han Xiao looked around, took out a piece of paper from behind the counter, wrote down his communicator number, and handed it to Li Yalin.

"You can call me anytime in the future. If you have any problems, you can come to me."

Li Yalin quickly calmed herself down, put the paper away carefully, paused, and said with an extremely serious tone, "Thank you."

"You're welcome. This amount of money is nothing."

"That's not what I meant." Li Yalin took a deep breath, bowed deeply, and said, "I'm thanking you on behalf of the entire Blue Star. What you did saved everyone, including me. I didn't have the chance to tell you before … You'll always be my hero."

Ames chuckled and joked, "What about me?"

"Yes, you're my hero too." Li Yalin hurriedly bowed again.

At this time, a few more guests walked in together. When they saw this scene, they were a little confused. After carefully looking for a while, they suddenly became excited.

"Your Excellency Black Star?!"

"Oh my god, it's really Black Star!"

These people rushed up and surrounded him. They were so excited that their faces were red.

Among a hundred Blue Star people, perhaps only one person did not know what Han Xiao looked like. Part of it was thanks to the landmark Black Star statue Bennett built in Black Star City, and part of it was thanks to the textbooks.

"Can … Can we take a picture with you?!" One of them said excitedly and took out his communicator.

"Of course." Han Xiao smiled. He had nothing to do anyway, so it was fine to take some time.

The few of them excitedly took turns to take photos with Han Xiao, and some passersby who were passing by were also attracted. Very soon, more people heard the news and arrived, forming a long line outside. This small exhibition hall became crowded, and it was extremely noisy and lively. It was as if it had turned into a fan meeting.

Han Xiao did not refuse anyone and took pictures with the happy Blue Star citizens. Camera flashes sounded continuously, and one photo after another was posted on Blue Star's social network by the excited citizens.

The news of the "Great One"'s appearance spread instantly, causing Blue Star's netizens to celebrate. Countless people flocked to the exhibition hall.

Looking at Han Xiao busily taking pictures with people, Ames's eyes sparkled, and the admiration in her eyes never disappeared.
